clue.text: He says he's unable to better himself, poor beggar

parts.note: to better something is to mend or improve it
the speaker referring to himself says I
can't means is unable to

explanation.surface: A down-and-out laments that he cannot improve his situation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He says' frames the phrase as speech: the beggar's own words 'mend I can't' (I can't mend myself) run together into one word.
explanation.definitionFit: A mendicant is a person who lives on alms, so a poor beggar is an exact synonym.

clue.text: Race who ride white horses?

parts.note: seems to be about riders on pale mounts, but white horses are foam-crested waves, ridden by sea folk

explanation.definitionFit: Mermaids and mermen form a mythical sea-dwelling people living among the breaking waves.

clue.text: Uppity boy a leading journalist investigated

indicators.note: in a down clue uppity means going up, so the word for boy is read upwards

parts.note: a son is a boy
ED is short for editor, the senior journalist

explanation.surface: A cheeky lad and a newspaper chief looked into things.
explanation.definitionFit: To have nosed around is to have pried or snooped, that is, probed into something.

clue.text: Trendy parties — coppers gain entrance to make checks

parts.note: in means fashionable or trendy

indicators.note: gaining entrance means the coins get inside the word for parties

parts.note: sects are factions or parties
P stands for pence, the copper coins

explanation.surface: Police get into fashionable gatherings to carry out checks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coppers' looks like police, but it is copper coins, pence, abbreviated P.
explanation.definitionFit: To inspect is to examine officially, to scrutinise or carry out an examination.

clue.text: Criminal beasts in the end

indicators.note: in the end says the word in is placed last, after the two beasts

parts.note: an ass is a beast of burden, and the plural asks for two of them
the second of the two beasts, another ass
taken as written

explanation.surface: Wild animals are lawbreakers when it comes down to it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beasts' gives two copies of ASS, and 'in the end' places IN at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: An assassin is a murderer of a prominent person, a kind of criminal.

clue.text: One offering a gratuity has tuppence in the bank

indicators.note: in tells us the two coins sit inside the word for bank

parts.note: a tier is a row or bank, as of seats
tuppence is two pence, written P and P

explanation.surface: A generous diner has just two pennies in their account.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the bank' suggests money, but it is a bank of seats, a TIER; TUPPENCE is British for twopence.
explanation.definitionFit: A tipper is someone who leaves a tip, a small extra payment for service.

clue.text: First to shoot in America gets a hole in the head

indicators.note: first to points at the opening letter of the following word only

parts.note: taken as written
US is the usual short form for the United States of America

explanation.surface: A gunman in the United States inflicts a head wound.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a shooting; 'a hole in the head' is literal anatomy, an air cavity in the skull.
explanation.definitionFit: The nasal cavities in the skull bones are air-filled spaces, literally holes in the head.

clue.text: Blunder in, shamefaced, for a drink

indicators.note: in tells us the word for blunder sits inside the word for shamefaced

parts.note: shy means bashful or shamefaced
to err is to blunder

explanation.surface: Someone embarrassed after a mistake turns to alcohol.
explanation.definitionFit: Sherry is a fortified wine from Spain, a popular aperitif.

clue.text: Quiet lionesses in a knot

indicators.note: letters tied in a knot are tangled, so lionesses is rearranged

explanation.surface: Big cats huddled silently together.
explanation.definitionFit: Noiseless means making no sound at all, silent.

clue.text: Little change in a good player's career

indicators.note: in tells us the coin sits inside the word for a good player

parts.note: a seed is a top-ranked player in a tennis tournament
P, a penny, is a small coin, little change

explanation.surface: A slight shift in a talented athlete's professional life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'career' looks like a noun for a profession; here it is the verb meaning to rush along.
explanation.definitionFit: To career is to rush headlong, to move at high velocity.

clue.text: Shows opposition to sisters getting involved

indicators.note: involved suggests the letters becoming tangled together, so the word sisters is rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone objects to their sisters joining in.
explanation.definitionFit: To resist is to stand against or oppose something.

clue.text: Control before the border

parts.note: pre- is a prefix meaning before
a side is an edge or border of something

explanation.surface: Someone takes charge ahead of reaching the frontier.
explanation.definitionFit: To preside is to chair or be in authority over a meeting, that is, to be in charge of it.

clue.text: A character expected to invest

parts.note: EN is the name of the letter N, one character of the alphabet
due means expected, as of a train arriving

explanation.surface: Someone thought likely to put money into a venture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'invest' is not finance here but the old sense of clothing or endowing someone with a quality.
explanation.definitionFit: To endue is to endow or clothe someone with a quality, the archaic sense of invest.

clue.text: Peers had a problem — aggressive leaders

indicators.note: having a problem suggests the letters of peers had a are in disorder and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: The House of Lords ran into trouble with its combative front-benchers.
explanation.definitionFit: A spearhead is the leading group in an attack or campaign, those at the front pushing forward.

clue.text: A green banana left a worker in great discomfort

indicators.note: in tells us the left-hand and worker letters sit inside the word for discomfort

parts.note: pain is severe discomfort
an ant is the classic worker insect

explanation.surface: Eating an unripe banana left a labourer in agony.
explanation.definitionFit: The plantain is a starchy cooking fruit of the banana family, usually eaten green.

clue.text: Looking for a sound round fruit

indicators.note: round means the sound word goes around the fruit

parts.note: a ping is a short ringing sound
a pear is a fruit

explanation.surface: Searching for a healthy round fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like an adjective meaning healthy and 'round' like a shape, but sound is PING and round the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Appearing means seeming, as in 'looking tired' and 'appearing tired'.

clue.text: The French vessel is smaller

parts.note: le is the French masculine word for the
SS stands for steamship, a vessel; the letters also appearing backwards inside the word vessel is a coincidence

explanation.surface: A French boat is the smaller one.
explanation.definitionFit: Less means of a smaller amount or size, a comparative adjective like smaller.

clue.text: Such building material sets, and no mistake!

indicators.note: a mistake suggests the letters of sets, and no have been jumbled

explanation.surface: A stone that hardens firmly, without any doubt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and no mistake' reads as an emphatic phrase, but 'mistake' is the anagram signal on the words before it.
explanation.definitionFit: Sandstone is a sedimentary rock widely quarried for use in building.

clue.text: A person expected to deal with a breakdown

definitions.text: A person expected to deal with a breakdown

parts.words: A person expected to deal with a breakdown
parts.note: suggests a mechanic or counsellor, but a breakdown here is a detailed examination of something into its parts

explanation.definitionFit: An analyser examines things by separating them into their components, producing a breakdown.

clue.text: Recovered and went through it all over again

definitions.meaning: re-covered, given a new covering, as a tyre given fresh tread

definitions.text: went through it all over again
definitions.meaning: summarised once more, short for recapitulated

explanation.definitionFit: A tyre is retreaded by being given new tread, and a speaker summarises by recapitulating the main points.

clue.text: See some ladies' pyjamas

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A glimpse of women's nightwear.
explanation.definitionFit: To espy is to catch sight of, an old literary verb for seeing.

clue.text: Moderate having to do for example broadcasting

parts.note: in re is Latin for in the matter of, having to do with
as can mean for example, as in 'cities as London'
on means on air, being broadcast

explanation.surface: Moderation being needed, for instance, on the airwaves.
explanation.walkthrough: IN RE is Latin legal shorthand for 'concerning'; it is commonly used in letters and crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: Within reason means within sensible limits, a moderate amount, not excessive.

clue.text: Give one thousand, not the lot

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
a part is not the whole lot

explanation.surface: Someone offers a thousand, but not everything.
explanation.definitionFit: To impart is to bestow or hand over, especially information.

clue.text: "Art never expresses anything but —", said Oscar Wilde

definitions.text: "Art never expresses anything but —", said Oscar Wilde

parts.words: "Art never expresses anything but —", said Oscar Wilde
parts.note: a fill-in-the-blank: the missing word completes Wilde's aphorism from The Decay of Lying

explanation.definitionFit: Wilde held that art is self-referential, expressing nothing beyond its own nature.

clue.text: Alarmed to get the shakes on the motorway

indicators.note: the shakes are trembling, so the letters of alarmed to are shaken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A driver frightened enough to tremble while driving on a major road.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: it means what is found on the motorway, crushed stone used for making roads.
explanation.definitionFit: Road metal is broken stone laid as the base of a road surface, the material under traffic.

clue.text: Cut with little hesitation when more mature

parts.note: to rip is to cut or tear
er is the short sound of a hesitating speaker

explanation.surface: A hesitant slice when the fruit has ripened.
explanation.definitionFit: Riper is the comparative of ripe, meaning further developed or matured.

clue.text: High peaks and points

parts.note: taken as written
E and S are compass points, east and south

explanation.surface: Mountain summits and various points of view.
explanation.definitionFit: The Andes are the long South American mountain range, famous for its lofty summits.

clue.text: Light-weight article written for show

parts.note: a dram is a small unit of weight
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A short newspaper piece written about a play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Light-weight article' suggests a trivial piece of writing; it is a small weight and the word A.
explanation.definitionFit: A drama is a play performed on stage, a theatrical production.

clue.text: Stiff note about a church official

parts.note: prim means stiffly formal and proper
te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A formal letter concerning a cleric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'note' suggests a written message, but it is the sol-fa note TE.
explanation.definitionFit: A primate is an archbishop or chief bishop of a province, a senior church office.

clue.text: She's always highly vocal!

parts.note: describes a noisy woman, but highly means at a high pitch: the top female singing voice

explanation.definitionFit: A soprano is a singer with the highest voice range, so her singing is always high.

clue.text: Exact due

definitions.meaning: due means what one is entitled to, an entitlement

explanation.definitionFit: Right means correct, as in the exact answer, and also an entitlement, what is owed to someone.

clue.text: The dragon ousted by a Lothario

parts.note: to be fired is to be ousted from a job
a Lothario is a seducer, a womaniser or rake, after the character in Rowe's play

explanation.surface: A fierce woman sacked by a womaniser.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The dragon' looks like a formidable woman, but it is a mythical fire-breathing beast.
explanation.definitionFit: A firedrake is a fire-breathing dragon of Germanic mythology.
